cases.summary: The binary under test reports itself compatible with schema/released.openrpc.json (ovis-terminal --json schema compat --released). The same binary is staged for this host (the staged and unpacked binaries hash to the binary under test, and the unpacked binary reports the entry's version and the source schema's digest), sealed into an archive whose bytes and .sha256 sidecar both hash to the recorded digest, unpacked as an installer would and run natively: versions, manual, schema and released compatibility agree, every file re-hashes and the notices list every Cargo.lock crate with the Apache-2.0 attribution. A complete five-target matrix uploaded as CI uploads it (entries, archives, sidecars, QA receipts; no staged directories) is unpacked and re-hashed, and promotes as a dry run that never publishes and states that nothing is signed.

cases.summary: A released baseline of the same generation that requires an output this build lacks makes the binary answer compatibility_break, the stage exit 1 with no entry written and the repository baseline unchanged. A tampered archive, a wrong .sha256 sidecar and an archive repacked with a tampered binary under re-recorded archive digests are checksum_mismatch naming the file, an entry with an unknown field is manifest_malformed, a matrix without the Windows artifact is target_missing, a missing native QA receipt is native_qa_missing, a QA receipt with failed checks (even one claiming passed) is native_qa_failed naming the checks, a macOS receipt from a Linux host is cross_build_refused, an unpinned SQLite is target_receipt_invalid, lost Apache attribution is notices_missing, a rerun after publication is already_published with publish false, and a rerun with different artifacts is release_conflict. With --inject only the named fixture runs.
